note: The settings area: profile, appearance, security (IAM-017 sessions, IAM-010f passkeys, password), organization, invoice design. Nothing here is needed for the core loop (FR-UX-003).

settings.sections_label.note: Accessible name of the settings sub-navigation.

settings.profile.language_hint.note: FR-LOC-001b: per person, follows the account.
settings.profile.language_hint.nl: Uw eigen keuze, op elk apparaat waar u inlogt. Verandert niets aan hoe bedragen worden geschreven.
settings.profile.language_hint.en: Your own choice, on every device you sign in on. Changes nothing about how amounts are written.

settings.appearance.theme_hint.nl: Systeem volgt uw apparaat, ook als dat 's avonds naar donker wisselt. Wordt per apparaat onthouden.
settings.appearance.theme_hint.en: System follows your device, including when it switches to dark in the evening. Remembered per device.

settings.security.password_hint.note: IAM-013: length over composition rules; breach-checked server-side.
settings.security.password_hint.nl: Minstens 12 tekens. Een zin die u onthoudt werkt beter dan een kort woord met cijfers.
settings.security.password_hint.en: At least 12 characters. A sentence you remember works better than a short word with digits.

settings.security.password_mismatch.nl: De twee wachtwoorden zijn niet gelijk.
settings.security.password_mismatch.en: The two passwords do not match.

settings.security.totp_remove_unavailabl.note: Honest about a missing capability rather than drawing a dead button (D5): the API has no route to remove a TOTP factor yet.
settings.security.totp_remove_unavailabl.nl: Een authenticator-app loskoppelen kan nog niet vanuit de app. Neem contact op met support als dat nodig is.
settings.security.totp_remove_unavailabl.en: Unlinking an authenticator app is not possible from the app yet. Contact support if you need this.

settings.security.passkeys_empty.nl: U heeft nog geen passkey. Met een passkey logt u in zonder wachtwoord en zonder code — één stap.
settings.security.passkeys_empty.en: You have no passkey yet. With a passkey you sign in without a password and without a code — one step.

settings.security.sessions_hint.note: IAM-017. Says what revoking does, and that the current session is left alone.
settings.security.sessions_hint.nl: Elke browser of telefoon waar u bent ingelogd. Intrekken logt dat apparaat direct uit; uw huidige sessie kunt u alleen via Uitloggen beëindigen.
settings.security.sessions_hint.en: Every browser or phone you are signed in on. Revoking signs that device out immediately; your current session can only be ended with Sign out.

settings.security.trusted_devices_title.note: ADR-061. Distinct from sessions above: a trusted device is a 7-day grant that lets a NEW sign-in skip the MFA prompt, not a live sign-in itself.

settings.security.trusted_devices_hint.nl: Apparaten waarop u "Onthoud dit apparaat" heeft aangevinkt bij het invoeren van uw code. Op deze apparaten wordt tot 7 dagen niet opnieuw om een code gevraagd. Intrekken vraagt bij de volgende keer inloggen weer om een code.
settings.security.trusted_devices_hint.en: Devices where you checked "Remember this device" when entering your code. These skip the code prompt for up to 7 days. Revoking asks for a code again on the next sign-in.

settings.organization.name_readonly.nl: De naam van uw organisatie is vastgelegd bij het aanmaken van uw account. Neem contact op met support om hem te wijzigen.
settings.organization.name_readonly.en: Your organization's name was set when your account was created. Contact support to change it.

settings.organization.no_administrations.nl: Een administratie is één boekhouding: de boeken van één bedrijf. Maak er een aan om te beginnen.
settings.organization.no_administrations.en: An administration is one set of books: one business's accounts. Create one to get started.

settings.organization.iban.note: SI-02. The administration's own bank account, used only to render the 'pay by bank' QR code on an invoice PDF. IBAN is the statutory term, unchanged between languages.

settings.organization.iban_placeholder.note: SI-02. A worked example IBAN (a real bank's public example number, not a live account) - identical in both languages because it is not prose, it is a format example.

settings.organization.iban_hint.nl: Voor de QR-code 'betalen met de bank' op uw facturen. Laat leeg om geen QR-code te tonen.
settings.organization.iban_hint.en: For the 'pay by bank' QR code on your invoices. Leave empty to show no QR code.

settings.organization.address.note: FR-AR-003. The seller's own address - not a customer's.

settings.organization.address_hint.note: Why it is asked: an invoice cannot be issued without it, and the invoice screen sends people here.
settings.organization.address_hint.nl: Verplicht op elke factuur (art. 35a Wet OB). Zonder straat, postcode en plaats kunt u geen factuur uitgeven.
settings.organization.address_hint.en: Required on every invoice (art. 35a Wet OB). You cannot issue an invoice without the street, postcode and city.

settings.organization.postal_code.note: Identical in both: 'postcode' is the ordinary English word on a Dutch-facing form as well.

settings.organization.country.note: A two-letter ISO code (NL, DE, BE), which is why the field is two characters wide.

settings.invoice_design.intro.note: FR-TPL: the template designer. Says what is fixed by law before the person looks for the switch that removes it (FR-TPL-009).
settings.invoice_design.intro.nl: Logo, lettertype, indeling en teksten van uw facturen. Wat de wet op een factuur verplicht stelt, staat vast en kunt u niet verbergen.
settings.invoice_design.intro.en: Logo, typeface, layout and wording of your invoices. What the law requires on an invoice is fixed and cannot be hidden.

settings.invoice_design.default_name.note: The name a brand-new administration's first template gets, created on first visit.
